format: BUFR (NCEP satwnd dump), decoded with earth2bufr
notes: u, v is both the HealDAv2 satwnd stream and the full NNJAObsSatwndLexicon VOCAB. layout='wide' as in the example (:116-118).

HealDAv2 reads [t-45h, t+3h] (8 six-hourly frames, +-3h each; example :107). The harness cannot express an asymmetric tuple tolerance, so time_tolerance_hours=3 benchmarks ONE frame of the window; a real model init is ~8x this.
Time is the example's analysis time; MIN_DATE 1979-01-01 (nnja.py:699).
layout='wide' frames have no 'variable' column, so the harness reports n_variables_returned = null (u and v are columns).
